_comment: Which part of the APK each file and dex class belongs to (tools/size/apksize.py, docs/size.md). Read from the module build files and the imports in each module's src/main (2026-11-13). The longest matching dex prefix wins; a class nothing matches is core. A library is counted in a pane's own total only when that pane alone uses it. A pane's `assets` are paths outside assets/panes/<id>/ that are its own (the radio bundle, which the app and release.yml expect at assets/radio-bundle/). A pane's `dex` lists its package and the classes elsewhere that only it uses (read 2026-11-13 from their users).

engine._why: GeckoView: its Java and native code, and omni.ja (Gecko's own JS, CSS and resources).

engines._why: Engines an app ships beside GeckoView, each its own row (Engine (<id>)).

vitro._why: Vitro, the native Lovelace renderer, its bundled Material Design icon table (vitro-mdi.tsv.gz, which the build stores decompressed) and its Java resources at its package path (the locale tables, native-options.json); and its WebRTC cameras in the apps that register them (engines/engine-vitro-webrtc), with libs/ha-webrtc and libwebrtc (webrtc-sdk's prefixed build: livekit.org.webrtc, liblkjingle_peerconnection_so.so)

bouncycastle._why: libs/esphome-api (Noise) brings it; Sendspin's encryption uses it too

media3._why: the core's voice and announcement player (ExoAudioPlayer, since R3 #343); GeckoView ships the same version (build.gradle.kts); Vitro plays live cameras' HLS on it (media3-exoplayer-hls)

tensorflow-lite._why: wake word inference, only in libs/voice

assist._why: the pane, its engine library (libs/voice, #152: the Assist client, the wake word, the microphone) and its overlay. dev.glassworks.assist is shared with the core (ExoAudioPlayer, TtsPlayer, VoiceLog, OrbArt: #352), so the pane's classes are listed one by one; test_apksize checks the list against the sources

sendspin._why: the pane and its engine library (libs/sendspin, #152). The library's WsClient also serves the core's HaThreadClient, and is counted here

radio._why: the signed radio bundle, which the release adds to armeabi-v7a (release.yml, RadioBundle.kt)

time-zone._why: TimeZoneKeeper is used only by TimeZonePane

camera._why: the camera pane (#117); CameraAdbActivity sets its settings from adb (the app's subclass at its old name, #22); the cards and the privacy dot are used by nothing else
